title: Cable Y-Raise
summary: A raise from crossed low cables up into a Y shape, for the side delts and lower traps.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for side delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.5 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Stand between two low pulleys and cross the cables so each hand holds the opposite handle.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y above shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arms up in a Y shape
Use light weight. Your shoulders should do this, not your back.

mistakes.text: Shrugging the traps up as the arms rise.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less upper-trap work, One side at a time.
Swap sheet: Less upper-trap work, Less isolation, Less stable.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
